bluetooth: Export GATT attribute interfaces as GATT client role In order to make the GATT attributes visible to D-Bus clients, this includes the following changes. - Adding gatt_interface_handler to export the discovered GATT services characteristics and descriptor to D-Bus - Implementation of observer mechanism in gatt.cc so that gatt_interface_handler can get notified on changes on GATT attributes - Determining how the D-Bus object properties should be updated and exported. We decided to go for the module where the interface handler needs to proactively go through all properties and update them. BUG=b:134425062 TEST=(1) Paired and connected to a BLE mouse from BT setting page. Verified in syslog that the D-Bus objects, methods and properties were exported for GATT services characteristics and descriptors. Ran subcommand "list-attributes" in bluetoothctl --service=org.chromium.Newblue and verified all attributes were printed. (2) Disconnected from the BLE mouse from BT setting page. Verified in syslog that the GATT attributes interfaces got removed and verified nothing got printed when running "list-attributes" subcommand with bluetoothctl --service=org.chromium.Newblue. Change-Id: If2b91c07531f12474aaa2ff9ac9f3e29d01fea44 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1716174 Tested-by: Miao-chen Chou <mcchou@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Yoni Shavit <yshavit@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Yu Liu <yudiliu@chromium.org>

bluetooth: Prevent exporting HID service via D-Bus and report completion of GATT browsing This uses a black list for hiding HID service from D-Bus clients for security reason until we come up with GATT profile manager. However, if any error occurs during primary service enumeration or primary service traversal, GATT observer will not get notified on completion. iproute2: Resync ARL qdisc attributes The ARL qdisc defines several Netlink attributes that are 64bit quantities. With the introduction of the nla_put_u64_64bit() helper [commit 73520786b079 ("libnl: add nla_put_u64_64bit() helper")] these attributes are forced to 64bit alignment. A new ARL attribute (TCA_ARL_PAD) is defined in the kernel pkt_sched.h file, which is inserted in the Netlink message when padding is required to achieve the necessary 64bit attribute alignment. The iproute2 package maintains its own private copy of the kernel pkt_sched.h file. This CL synchronizes the kernel TCA_ARL_xxx attribute list with the iproute2 private pkt_sched.h, this picks up the new TCA_ARL_PAD to ensure the 'tc qdisc show' command can properly recognize and decode Netlink messages when ARL Qdisc is active. BUG=b:138685581 TEST=System test: % tc qdisc add dev wan0 root handle 1: arl minrate 4800kbit \ buffer 5000 limit 500 latency 100ms latency_hysteresis 30ms % tc -s qdisc show dev wan0 Change-Id: I81aaedb904b4b8afffd879380faad72e60600ab3 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1732488 Tested-by: Danny Mitzel <mitzel@google.com> Commit-Ready: Danny Mitzel <mitzel@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
